fullSource:
use IO.Std.write_line

let fibonacci = n =>
    assert n >= 0 else "fibonacci is not defined for a negative argument" in
    (i rec => if i < 2 then i else rec(i - 1) + rec(i - 2) fi)(n)

for n in 0::10 do
    write_line("fibonacci({n}) = {fibonacci(n)}")
od
